data.summary_en: FREEEVOLVE replaces a hand-designed fixed search loop with an evolver autonomously deciding tests, evaluation, trade-offs, and stopping via an editable evolution skill; on tau3-bench, ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3, and Terminal-Bench 2.1, it raises main held-out metrics by 13.6 points on average, matching or exceeding hand-designed evolvers.
